summary: Draw the group-averaged functional connectivity network as an anatomical wiring diagram — regional centroids as nodes and FC strength as coloured edges — overlaid on the Mapzebrain top (XY) and side (XZ) brain projections, with the weakest quartile of connections hidden.
use_when: Analyze functional connectivity network drawn on the brain atlas
Generate functional connectivity network drawn on the brain atlas outputs
avoid_when: Connectivity estimates are unsupported because sampling, preprocessing, or matrix alignment is inadequate
Atlas labels, coordinates, or registrations are missing or incompatible
